headline: IQVIA has launched AI models designed to help drug companies predict how clinical trials will turn out.
score_reason: Kept at 6: a major company's launch, but the release gives no performance data.
importance_line: What is new: a large trial-services firm is offering drugmakers AI forecasts of trial results, which could shape how future studies that patients join are designed, and the honest doubt is that the claims rest on the company's own launch release.
summary: IQVIA, a clinical research services company listed on the New York Stock Exchange, says in a press release that its new IQVIA Life Science Models let trial sponsors, the companies that run studies, try out a study on a computer and check its main assumptions before it starts, so risks can be spotted earlier. The models are built with NVIDIA technology and run on Amazon Web Services, but the release gives no accuracy figures or results from real trials.
notes: Read on BioSpace press-release page (copy of the Business Wire release). Business Wire original link not found. Source is the distributor of the company release.
